items.title: Manny Albam interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: Occasionally I would play chess with Charlie Parker I remember in Philadelphia. I ran into him, he was in a club and we were in the theater, and I’d known him from a previous time.

ctx.x: Gee, were you at that game that had that famous picture of Y.A. Tittle with the helmet off?

Yeah, but I thought that was in San Francisco. I don’t think that was in Yankee Stadium. Anyway. So I was a pretty good athlete as a kid too, and I still feel that there is some kind of affinity between athleticism and music, and I can’t figure it out. And there is also with mathematics and chess and all those things. Occasionally I would play chess with Charlie Parker I remember in Philadelphia. And so you were evenly matched.
